title: Cross-border Bitcoin payments reduce remittance costs global
content: <div class="tldr-section"><em><strong>TL;DR: Bitcoin's robust network, operating at Block Height 935,684 with a hashrate of 986.51 EH/s, is proving an increasingly viable antidote to costly global remittance systems. This computational security underpins a permissionless rail that significantly lowers transfer fees, challenging traditional financial intermediaries that extract billions from the world's most vulnerable. For transactors, understanding current network conditions is key to leveraging Bitcoin for efficient, sovereign cross-border payments, bypassing the inefficiencies of fiat
author: Al Ingle
